info.name: e_season API
info.description:
Sri Lanka Railways season-ticket prototype backend. Flow: OTP -> register -> staff approval -> application -> sandbox pay -> scan.
Demo staff passwords come from `npm run db:seed` (default ChangeMe#2026).

request.description: Saves the first and last station ids into fromStationId / toStationId.
Non-production: the response includes devCode, which is saved to otpCode automatically.
Existing account returns `token` (saved as userToken). New number returns `registrationToken` (saved as registrationToken).

item.name: Registration
item.description: Run Auth > Request OTP and Verify OTP with a new phone number first to get a registrationToken.

request.description: Attach JPEG/PNG files (max 5 MB each) for photo, nicFront, nicBack. Phone comes from the OTP token.
Use simulate: "fail" to get a 402 declined payment (non-production only).
Works with station, officer or admin token. Saves first pending user id to pendingUserId.
Type: photo | nic_front | nic_back. Every view is audit-logged.
Institution officer only. decision: approved | rejected (reason required on reject).
Result: valid | expired | revoked | invalid. Station staff or admin.
